entities.name: Zoilus I
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoilus I Dicaeus was an Indo-Greek king who ruled in Afghanistan and Pakistan, and occupied the areas of the Paropamisade and Arachosia previously held by Menander I. He may have belonged to the dynasty of Euthydemus I.
